EchoSrDescription: Measured values: read from the sonographer's structured report (DICOM SR), not estimated by an AI model.

EchoSrNoGrading: No aortic valve Doppler measurement in the SR: aortic stenosis not graded.
EchoSrNoSummary: None of the key measurements is in the SR.
EchoSrMeasuredFirstNote: Measured by the sonographer (echo SR). The AI estimates below do not replace these values.
PanEchoAsScreeningNote: Screening scores, not a diagnosis. PanEcho reads the 2D clips only, without the Doppler spectra: the AV peak velocity is an AI estimate that under-estimates severe AS, and a low score does not rule out aortic stenosis. Use the measured Doppler values (Vmax, mean gradient, valve area).
